== Notes ==
* The caster's party is healed, not the party of the dead ally.
* This skill can be remarkably effective when used on [[minion]]s.
* Heroes use this skill on allies under 75% health.
** Heroes may roam far away from the party to use this skill on an ally even if set on guard.
